cmd:
# Скачать файлы с GitHub
cd /tmp
curl -s -H 'Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN' -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw'   'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/main/bot/classic/classic_runs_dashboard.py'   -o classic_runs_dashboard.py
curl -s -H 'Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN' -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw'   'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/main/bot/classic/classic-dashboard.service'   -o classic-dashboard.service

# Скопировать файлы в нужные места
sudo cp classic_runs_dashboard.py /opt/trading-bot/classic/classic_runs_dashboard.py
sudo cp classic-dashboard.service /etc/systemd/system/classic-dashboard.service

# Перезагрузить systemd, включить и запустить service
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable classic-dashboard.service
sudo systemctl start classic-dashboard.service

# Проверка статуса
sleep 2
sudo systemctl is-active classic-dashboard.service
curl -s http://localhost:18092 | grep -o 'Прогоны' | head -1
echo '✓ Dashboard запущен на http://localhost:18092'
